bio: Spoiler: this restaurant does indeed boast a magnificent panoramic view! This is, of course, best appreciated from the terrace, but you can also enjoy the sight of the mountains from inside through the floor-to-ceiling windows. The seasonal cuisine is regional Austrian. With dishes such as Wiener schnitzel and juicy goulash with sour cream, salmon trout from the Ötztal and Bregenzerwald cheese spaetzle, as well as Kaiserschmarrn (Austrian pancake dessert) – the menu promises a feast. Lila Pause, a bar with outdoor lounge, is also pleasant. As well as Panoramarestaurant, Hotel Alpenstern has another restaurant: Löffelspitze.
